title: THE WATERS OF NOAH WILL BE FIRE

sense.text:
“Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear”: the barren is our foremother Sarah, the wife of Abraham. She was desolate; she could not have children. “For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the Lord.” The married wife was Hagar, the mother of Ishmael. Sarah had more children: Israel numbers as the sand of the sea.

That is why we outnumber all nations on this planet. It is propaganda when they say we are about 13% of the population. They may be counting American blacks, but they are not counting the Jamaicans, the Haitians, the Puerto Ricans or the Mexicans.

“Enlarge the place of thy tent”: where we dwell, where we are going to live. “And let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations”: Isaiah gives an analogy of us having a tent, a tabernacle, when we dwell in Jerusalem. A tent has cords to hold it up, “lengthen thy cords”, and stakes to keep it from falling down, “strengthen thy stakes”. Israel is going to be that large.

“For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left”: we are going to be so large that we break out on the right hand and on the left. “And thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles”: to inherit the Gentiles means to own them, to possess them, “and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.”

Why don’t the churches ever read this kind of thing? Why don’t the apologists ever read it?

“Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame”. Why does he say fear not? Because in the future there will be things that, to the natural man, will put us in fear. Why “thou shalt not be ashamed”? Because things will happen that seem to bring us to shame. Why “neither be thou confounded”? Because things will come that might confound us, and he is telling us they won’t. “For thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth”: we are going to forget the sins of our youth, “and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.”

Look at what is going on in the world today. Around 1919 Breasted wrote Ancient Times and described the ancient Egyptians as dark-skinned people with woolly hair. Rockefeller loved that book and gave him $1.5 million for the Oriental Institute at the University of Chicago, and in the second edition, around 1935, every reference to the Egyptians being dark-skinned was taken out and a chapter added calling them the great white race. That is what Esau has been doing, and they have stepped their game up. It is meant to bring shame on his household: the ancient Egyptians and the Israelites looked so alike that Moses and the apostle Paul were taken for Egyptians, so when they make the Egyptians Caucasian, they are making the Israelites white too. And some of our own people now repeat that talking point without knowing any history. The ancient Egyptians were Hamites, and amongst Ham were the Shemites, our people in captivity there. Now an Egyptian representative at the UN says they are not related to the ancient Egyptians at all, only inhabitants of the land, after Kevin Hart was cursed out for saying the ancient Egyptians were black.

Now AI companies are buying up millions of old books and destroying them. They are not after the books made last year or last decade; they want the old books, and that is a fight against us, because we are the ones using old books alongside the Bible. They are going to remove every reference to the Jews being black and to Christ being black. A book can be copied page by page on a scanner without ever cutting the spine, so destroying it is done on purpose: once it is in that format it can be edited and the important pieces taken out. Old books are revised over time, version two, version three, with words changed and images whitewashed: the old Russian icons are black, the new ones white. The new editions of The Thirteenth Tribe took out the man who would eat the lice and wear his drawers until they disintegrated off his behind. An old book from the 1600s says Pope Nicholas the 5th began his rule in 1441, and Google says 1447.

If they will go to this length, color does matter. The proper image of yourself gives you your confidence, and taking it away is how they keep exploiting us. That is why the Most High always had us get hard copies. Get your own copy; don’t rely on Google. They will do things that seem to make us ashamed and confound us, but we shall not be ashamed.

precepts.why:
“For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction”: we got destroyed. Yet that land “shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants”. The land of Israel, whose capital is Jerusalem, will not be enough to hold all twelve tribes. “And they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.”

“The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other”: the two-thirds that were destroyed. They “shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.” It is too narrow for us; give us enough room that we can all live. That is why Isaiah 54 says to enlarge the place of the tent and lengthen the cords.

“Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee”: that is Christ. “Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.”

Heathen and Gentiles have the same meaning. The heathen are given to Christ for his inheritance, and so the seed of Israel inherits the Gentiles.

“And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee”: that is what it means to inherit the Gentiles. We shall own and possess them. “For in my wrath I smote thee”: that is slavery; in his wrath he allowed us to go into slavery. “But in my favour have I had mercy on thee”: that is Christ dying on the cross and delivering us.

“Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night”: the gates of New Jerusalem. Why? “That men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles”: the wealth, the riches of the Gentiles, because it is ours. It has always been ours. “And that their kings may be brought”: brought as slaves.

“For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.” It starts with Christ. He is our king, and his orders are our orders: he gives us an order and we carry it out to the nations. Whoever does not obey shall perish.

sense.text: “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked”: the wicked rules this earth. He is in control of these AI systems and these data banks. “He covereth the faces of the judges thereof”: he covers God’s truth with lies; he hides the truth. The judges are God the Father, God the Son, the angels and the Israelites, and he covers all their faces, as Leonardo da Vinci did when he painted Cesare Borgia as the new Jesus Christ. That is what they do.

precepts.why:
“Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth”: that goes right with Job 9:24. He covers the truth, and God anointed this white man to do it. An anointed cherub is an anointed spirit, an anointed angel; that is who they are.

“And I have set thee so”: God says, I set you so; I created you to do that. “Thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.” That is the devil, and that is Cain.

sense.text: “And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.” He is going to destroy all the lies this white man has cast over all people: that God is white, that Jesus is white, that the angels are white, that the Jews are white. That covering is the work of the anointed cherub that covereth.

precepts.why:
A precept for the covering: “For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth”. Covered with what? Sin, lies and deceit. “And gross darkness the people”: the people are the twelve tribes, and we are in the worst type of darkness.

“But the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.”

“And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God”: he is the white man, beginning with the Roman Catholic Church in the time of the Renaissance. The blasphemy is lies, wicked lies. “To blaspheme his name”: the Roman Catholic Church, Christianity, blasphemed the name of God. “And his tabernacle”: that is the Israelites. “And them that dwell in heaven”: the angels.

“And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them”: it was the Roman Catholic Church under Pope Nicholas in Rome that commanded Spain and Portugal to make war with the saints of God, and the saints of God are the twelve tribes of Israel. They overcame us and enslaved us. “And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.”

“And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him”. How so? Through the blasphemy of verse 6: the lies, the deceit and the deception he taught when he conquered us and the nations. He taught Christianity, Eurocentric lies, white supremacy. That is the covering cast over all people, “whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.”

sense.text: “They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain”: that is the wild animals. “For the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.” This is the time to come, what we are waiting for: the earth full of the knowledge of the Lord, and the knowledge means the laws of the Lord.

precepts.why:
“For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.” This is what we are waiting for: the earth filled with the knowledge of the Lord, meaning his laws.

Read on: “Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him”: that is this white man. He teaches us lies. “And makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!” They cause us to sin, telling us it is okay to break God’s laws, and wait till we follow, and then point and say, look at what they are doing.

sense.text:
“As the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty”: the serpent is Satan, the spiritual demon, who tricked Eve, our foremother, through his trickery. Paul does not want our minds to “be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.”

And as Satan beguiled Eve, he always gets the black woman first and foremost. A black woman on the street says Jesus is white, that she saw him, with long hair just like in the pictures, and tells a white man he looks like Jesus. That is the foolishness, the diabolical deceit, and it is why Africa stays colonized. As long as you worship a white Jesus, you ain’t ruling nothing. You can’t even govern your damn self.

Colonization starts in the mind. First they say color doesn’t matter; then they scrub the ancient records and destroy the ancient books so you can’t go back and check anything, and they sully everybody who comes with the truth. A black woman with no connection to Christ being black will teach her sons and her children that, and she becomes a strong pillar of white supremacy wherever she goes: the seed of colonialism, and the destruction of her own people. Image is everything. Knowing what Christ looked like and what the Israelites looked like lets you look at yourself as the greatness the Lord has given you, and you will act on that greatness when you know you are tied to it.

“For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus”: that goes with Revelation 13:6, his blasphemy and his conquering of the whole earth. That is this white man. He came and preached a European Jesus who came from France, who came from Rome. “Whom we have not preached”: none of the disciples preached a Eurocentric Jesus. Ask a Christian to show you in the Bible that Jesus is European. They all taught it, and now that we can confound them in front of the masses, they lie and say nobody ever taught it.

“Or if ye receive another spirit”: when you receive another Jesus, you receive another spirit, the spirit of antichrist, “or another gospel”. Another Jesus comes with another spirit and another gospel. That kills the lie the Christians tell, that his image doesn’t matter and only his message is important. If the man who conquered us, who raped, robbed and murdered us, taught us nothing but lies, what makes you think he is going to teach you the keys to the kingdom of heaven? You have been taught another gospel.

“Ye might well bear with him”: the way we bear with people is by showing them and correcting them in the Holy Bible.

“For thy Maker is thine husband”: that Maker is Christ. “The Lord of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.” The Lord was never married to all the nations on the earth. He was married only to Israel.

“For the Lord hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit”: the twelve tribes of Israel are represented as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit. Grieved with what? Lies, poverty, death and destruction. “And a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God”: refused because we were sinning. He called us to return, for he was married to us, and we didn’t want to return, so the Most High refused us.

“For a small moment have I forsaken thee”: it seems like forever to you and me, but to the Lord it is only a small moment. “But with great mercies will I gather thee”: he is going to gather us. That is what Christ dying on the cross is about: gathering us back together again.

“In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment”: that is slavery. When he hid his face, that is the chains, the ships, poverty, sickness, death and destruction; it all sums up right there. “But with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the Lord thy Redeemer.”

precepts.why:
“Turn, O backsliding children, saith the Lord; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion”. He is married to Israel, the backsliding children.

That goes with the marriage supper of the Lamb, which the Christians say they will be at. They will not: not the Catholics, the Baptists, the Episcopalians, the Anglicans, the Muslims or the Mormons.

“But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.” To us it has been thousands of years, but the Lord says it is only a small moment. It has been one day in the Lord’s time.

“And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.” That is the little wrath, when he hid his face from us for a moment.

“But unto the wicked God saith”: the wicked is this so-called white man that our people love and adore so much. “What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?” Who took the old covenant in their mouth? The white man. Who took the New Testament covenant in their mouth? The white man. One group says the Old Testament is theirs as Jewish people; another says the new covenant is theirs in Jesus as Christians. They say they are the people of God, which goes back to the blasphemies of Revelation 13. They have churches all over the place, and they indoctrinated us.

“Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee”: both groups hate God’s laws, and they do nothing this Bible says. “When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him”: that is why, as Netanyahu takes the land of Palestine, nobody says anything, and America says go ahead. Might makes right. Nobody said anything when the whites took over South Africa, Australia and America. “And hast been partaker with adulterers”: raping women. “Thou givest thy mouth to evil”: to lies and blasphemy, “and thy tongue frameth deceit”: the deceit we have been reading about from the beginning, the anointed cherub that covereth.

“Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.” We are Jacob, the brother of Esau; they are Esau, the wicked brother, and they speak against us and say we are nothing but Gentiles, savages, lowlifes, monkeys and apes.

“These things hast thou done, and I kept silence”: that is the little moment he hid his face. A pastor whose niece died of brain cancer was upset and asked why God would do that. All these evil things have happened to us, and God kept silent: he is not intervening in some things. He sits back and observes us, because this is the time for us to get our lives together, to repent, and to put the pieces of the puzzle in the Bible together. “Thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself”: the white man said within himself, God isn’t intervening, he isn’t hurting us, so surely God is a white man.

“But I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes”: that is what is happening now. They are shocked that we are getting our hands on those old books, and they always ask where we found them, which means who taught you, so they can shut that school down. Their whole objective is to make sure we learn nothing about ourselves, and they think deep. Back in the 90s brothers in the Strand bookstore in New York were asked if they weren’t in the wrong section, and a book they left on the shelf to go get money was gone, and the staff acted as if it never existed; they had to hide the book in another section and come back for it. Getting the teaching of slavery out of the schools, destroying the books on slavery, teaching that blacks were already here and never came over on slave ships: all of that is a battle against the word of God, and they are going to lose.

sense.text: We just saw a map of the hangings of black people since 2018. “Blessed be the Lord God of Israel”: he is not the God of everybody; he is only the God of the Israelites. “For he hath visited and redeemed his people”: redemption is only for his people, the Israelites.

“And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David”: the horn represents the kingship, the king. He has raised up a king of salvation for us in the house of his servant David. That is Christ.
“As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began”: since the world began, the prophets prophesied the coming of the Messiah, and that starts with Genesis 3:15.
“That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us”: Christ is going to redeem us from all that hate us.
“To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant”: the covenant he made with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, “The oath which he sware to our father Abraham”.

“That we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear”. Right now we serve the Lord in fear. Some say they don’t, but if you have a job, you serve the Lord in fear. Take off to keep the new moon this month and next month, or say you can’t work on the Passover, and you are fired. That is serving the Lord with fear, and there are many other examples.

This white man is a beast. Don’t tell me about Pooky and Ray Ray: there is nobody more violent than this so-called white man. “And from the days of John the Baptist until now”: until the time of Christ, “the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence”. The kingdom of heaven is the nation of Israel. Nobody was jumping up in the sky punching God in the face and kicking the angels around; he was talking about the nation of Israel. “And the violent take it by force”: the violent man at that time was Rome.

precepts.why:
“Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man”: not only is he a violent man, God says he is an evil man. “Preserve me from the violent man”: this evil man is the violent man, the white man. “Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.” In a time of peace the white man will make sure there is a war, because war brings money. If there is no war, they will create one; they cannot sit around while the earth is quiet.

“They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent”: they speak lies and deceit, their philosophies, their politics, their religions. “Adders’ poison is under their lips”: their lies are like poison.

“Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man”: David’s prayer is our prayer too. “Who have purposed to overthrow my goings.” The white man in that video said it was never about race, it was about money. The Bible says their purpose is to overthrow the twelve tribes of Israel. What was the purpose of Cain? To kill Abel. That has always been their purpose, because they are violent and evil, and that is not me saying it; the Bible says it. Churches will never read this, because it might pinpoint the white man.

“Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.” The Bible prophesies what is going to happen to this white man.

“I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted”: we are the afflicted, and he is going to maintain our cause. That is why Christ said to pray for vengeance. “And the right of the poor”: we are the poor in spirit. “Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.”

Christ says something else that goes with Matthew 11:12: “The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy”. The thief is Rome. Rome came to steal, to kill and to destroy. It is not enough for them to steal: they kill you, and then they destroy everything. Look at Africa; look at the Aborigines in Australia; South Africa; America. Steal, kill, destroy.

A white man says it himself: black people are being lynched all over the South, and when another body is found hanging from a tree they call it suicide. It is not just because of Trump; he only made it more obvious. Republicans are the wolf and the Democrats the fox, and both mean to eat you; the fox just comes with a smile.

A Hispanic father walking with his son at dawn is slammed to the ground for not showing ID. That is the slave master’s mentality: you are my slave, and I have to know where you are every second, because you belong to me. It was done on purpose to terrorize that son, so he grows up feeling like a slave with no protection, fidgety in school, put in special classes and prepared for prison: the school-to-prison pipeline. Hanging our brothers all over the country sends the same message, so that we adjust to terrorism and are afraid even to speak. So we have to pray for vengeance. We have to pray for the Lord to kill our enemies, and there is nothing wrong with that.

sense.text: Although it seems the Most High has done nothing and kept silent through all these things, watch what he says: “In all their affliction he was afflicted”. When we get afflicted, the Most High is saying, I get afflicted too. “And the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them”: that is what we are waiting for. “And he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.”

“And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God”. What is good about what we have just been watching and listening to? All of it, because the Lord has been warning our people, our twelve tribes, for centuries in the Bible, and we have not been listening. We have not repented or returned to him. We went into strange religions and worshipped a strange god that you think is Jesus Christ. All things work together for good, and that includes the things we think are bad for us: there is a divine purpose behind it. “To them who are the called according to his purpose”: we are the called according to his purpose, our people.

“For whom he did foreknow”: knew from the past. Go back to the Old Testament: whom did he foreknow? The twelve tribes of Israel. “He also did predestinate”: he predestinated the twelve tribes of Israel “to be conformed to the image of his Son”, to transform us into the image of Christ, “that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.”

“Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified”: Paul is not saying everybody on the planet is going to be justified. “And whom he justified, them he also glorified”: glorified in his Son.
“If God be for us, who can be against us?” Meaning, who can conquer us? Who can destroy us? Nobody on this planet, no matter what comes our way.

“Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?” It is a question. “As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long”: the prophets, the servants of God. “We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

As it is written: Paul got this from Psalms 44. He didn’t just make things up and pull them out of the sky; he based it on the scriptures, which is why he would often tell Timothy to bring the books and the parchments so he could write.

“Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors”: no matter what happens. That goes back to verse 31: if God be for us, who can be against us means we are conquerors; Paul just says it in different words. “Through him that loved us”: through Christ, who loved us.

Neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature “shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.” Nothing can separate us from the love of God, which means we are more than conquerors. There is nothing these people can do to our flesh and bones to destroy us forever. Christ said to fear not him that can destroy the body, but him that can destroy both soul and body in hell: Christ is the only one who can destroy us.

precepts.why: “Whom he did foreknow” goes with Amos: “Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying, You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.” You only have I known: those are the ones he foreknew.
“In the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified”. We are the ones being justified, not all the nations on the planet. Paul is getting “them he also justified” from right there.

sense.text: “Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons”: the place of dragons is the seven heads of the great red dragon, and their lands: Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia, Great Britain, and the eighth head, America. “And covered us with the shadow of death”: he has allowed these dragons to teach us lies, as a punishment for disobeying his commandments.

“If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god”: here in our captivity we have stretched out our hands to their strange god, the one you think is Jesus: white Jesus, like the black woman who said Jesus is white, with long hair, and told a white man he looked like Jesus. We have stretched out our hands to a strange god, and we have forgotten the name of our God.
“Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.”
“Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.” This is where Paul got Romans 8:36 from.

“Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever. Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?” We want the Lord to intervene now. But the Lord says no: get yourselves together. You men, you women, get yourselves right according to my word.
“For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth. Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.”

precepts.why: The strange god: “Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god”. He is the white man, starting with the Greeks all the way up to today. Here in our captivity we have stretched out our hands to their strange god. “Whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory”: he robbed everything. “And he shall cause them to rule over many”: he causes his European allies to rule over many. “And shall divide the land for gain”: they divided the land of Israel, and the land of Africa at the Berlin Conference, for gain.

“They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods”: we provoked the Lord to jealousy with strange gods. This white Jesus is an example of a strange god; Allah is a strange god. “With abominations provoked they him to anger.”

“If ye forsake the Lord, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt”. Have we not been hurt in slavery, captivity, oppression and poverty? Yes. “And consume you, after that he hath done you good”: after he had given us the promised land. But we didn’t learn our lesson from there.

“There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.” We have done just that. We worship a god that does not look like us, act like us or talk like us; we pray to it and want that strange god to bless us, and it has done nothing but hurt us. Some of our mothers and fathers have that crucifix around their necks and on the walls of their homes, and go to those churches worshipping a strange god.

“Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.” What have we done? We have envied the oppressor, and we have chosen his ways: we want the white man’s strange god and the white man’s strange religion.

“Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.” But we have been envious of evil men. We want into their politics, their religions, their caucus. We want to sit on their toilets, go to school with them, look like them. The Bible says don’t do that, and the churches have done us a disservice.

It is all demonic activity. “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world”. We read that and pass it by and think America is not like that. Oh yes, it is. “Against spiritual wickedness in high places.”

In the Catholic Church they put a human skull inside an idol: these are demonic rituals summoning the powers of Satan, though we look at them and don’t understand. Some of our people in Roman Catholicism will fight you for trying to wake them out of that spell. The Vatican is one of those principalities: spiritual wickedness in high places.

sense.text: “For this is as the waters of Noah unto me”: this is the Lord speaking through Isaiah. “For as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth”: he promised that the waters of Noah would no more go over the earth. “So have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee”: that he would not punish us.

precepts.why:
The waters of Noah: “neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.” “I do set my bow in the cloud”: the bow is the rainbow, “a token of a covenant between me and the earth.” “The bow shall be seen in the cloud”, the rainbow in the cloud, and “the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.”

“This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.” That is the oath Isaiah 54:9 points back to: the waters of Noah shall no more go over the earth.

“But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be”: Noe is the Greek; it is still Noah. The Son of man is Christ. “They were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark”: nations of people eating and drinking and giving one another in marriage, while Noah was warning the people to repent and change their ways.

“And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away”: took is the past tense of take. Took them away into what? Not the kingdom of heaven: destruction and death. “So shall also the coming of the Son of man be.” So when “the one shall be taken, and the other left”, the one is taken into destruction, and the one left is the righteous. Two in the field, two women grinding at the mill: one taken to destruction, the other left. “Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.”

“But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come”: the goodman of the house, in this context, is the white man, the one you think is good, who made you think he is holy and righteous. Christ said he would come as a thief: Christ is the thief in this verse. “Therefore be ye also ready”: brothers and sisters, we have to be ready, “for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.”

The scripture calls Noah a preacher of righteousness: “And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness”. Righteousness means God’s laws, so Noah was a preacher of God’s laws. Noah was preaching to the people, and the people mocked him and laughed at him.

“Hear, O ye my beloved, saith the Lord: behold, the days of trouble are at hand, but I will deliver you from the same.” The Lord says, I will deliver you from the same. “Be ye not afraid, neither doubt; for God is your guide, And the guide of them who keep my commandments and precepts, saith the Lord God: let not your sins weigh you down, and let not your iniquities lift up themselves.”

This is the same thing Noah was preaching back then, but nobody listened. Everybody mocked him.

sense.text: “For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed”: destruction. “But my kindness shall not depart from thee”: God’s kindness shall not depart from the twelve tribes of Israel, “neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the Lord that hath mercy on thee.” The Lord is having mercy on the twelve tribes of Israel.

“O thou afflicted”: although we are afflicted, that is us; we are the afflicted. “Tossed with tempest, and not comforted”: we have not been comforted. “Behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours”: we are going to have a crown, rubies and emeralds. “And lay thy foundations with sapphires”: that is the kingdom.
“And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles”: more precious stones, “and all thy borders of pleasant stones”, rubies and diamonds.
“And all thy children shall be taught of the Lord; and great shall be the peace of thy children.”

“In righteousness shalt thou be established”: the twelve tribes shall be established. “Thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.” Terror shall no more come near us.

And this white man has terrorized us. Black Americans found hanging from trees from 2024 through 2026, Trey Reed, Tasia Fortune and so many more, and the white man says it is all suicide, that they did it to themselves. Some say it is the police. The police do have a part to play in it, but it is not just the police: the ones who killed Ahmaud Arbery were not the police, and neither were those behind Rasheem Carter and Kendrick Johnson.
“Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me”: the nations shall gather together, but not by the Lord. “Whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.”

precepts.why: He will lay our foundations with stones, rubies and emeralds: “And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald”, on through the sardonyx, the sardius, the chrysolite, the beryl, the topaz, the chrysoprasus and the jacinth, to “the twelfth, an amethyst.” The foundations laid with sapphires in Isaiah 54:11 are the foundations of that city, the kingdom.
“And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.” When he pleads with us face to face, that is “all thy children shall be taught of the Lord”.

“For now we see through a glass, darkly”: the glass is the Bible. We don’t understand everything in here. There are different levels; many scriptures have double meanings. “But then face to face”.

“Now I know in part”: we know partially. “But then shall I know”: when the Lord returns, then we shall know, “even as also I am known.” He created us from the beginning, before the earth was made. Then all thy children shall be taught of the Lord.
It is not just the police. God says: “As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.” God says he hates Esau, and that is who they are. It is all of them.

“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness”: Edom, Esau, they shall call them the border of wickedness, “and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” God has righteous anger against them forever, because they are the culprits. They are the terrorists.

It is not just the police, and it is not just one guy, not just a Dylann Roof. It is all of them; they are all complicit, even the nice ones who benefit from the murder and robbery their ancestors did. Keep telling your kids it is only the police, and they will lower their guard to their so-called friends at school, and be put to death because of that parenting.

“Thus saith the Lord my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter”: that is the twelve tribes. Remember, for thy sake we are killed all the day long. “Whose possessors slay them”: who possesses us? Esau, Edom, and they kill us, “and hold themselves not guilty”. A family asks for the body for an independent look, and they send back a husk with no lungs, no stomach, no throat, and there is no public outcry; the courts say nothing.

But all things work together for good for those that love God. There is a divine purpose behind this: we must see and acknowledge who the devil is, who the children of the devil are on earth. Before the 60s, in the Jim Crow era, we had a common enemy, and all our people knew the white man was the devil. Then civil rights came, and now he is our friend. Now God is stirring this white man right back up to make America great again, and people ask why this is happening and say they are confused. If you had kept your head in the Bible, you wouldn’t be confused.

“And they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich”: they sold us and said blessed be the Lord. “And their own shepherds pity them not”: our own black leaders pity us not. Ask Clarence Thomas, who is trying to get rid of the affirmative action that got him where he is: I got mine, get yours on your own.

It is the two Americas. A white grandmother leaves a baby in a car and is not charged, and white women pour out compassion; a black mother who forgot her child, Deja Coleman, is charged with murder and sent to the funeral in an orange suit, shackled. A teen who raped and strangled two girls gets zero days in prison, and the predators in the Epstein files will not be prosecuted. This whole system is built on white supremacy, a white power structure, and our people think they are included. You are not included. This system was created to oppress you, to terrorize you.

“In this the children of God are manifest”: we are the children of God, the Israelites, made manifest. “And the children of the devil”: look around; who is he talking about? The same ones we just read about in Malachi 1:4, the border of wickedness, the people against whom the Lord has indignation forever. Those are the children of the devil. “Whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother”: black and Latin people fall in that too, because they follow the white man and have chosen his ways.

“For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another. Not as Cain”: they are Cain, and we are Abel. “Who was of that wicked one”: of the devil, the anointed cherub that covereth, “and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.” Remember Psalms 140: the evil man is the violent man, one and the same.

sense.text: Read verse 15 with it: they shall surely gather together, and whosoever gathers together against thee shall fall. How will the Lord do it? “Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire”: a smith is somebody who makes weapons. Oppenheimer created the first atom bomb, the greatest weapon that ever existed, and since then their technology has been enhanced to another level of nuclear beyond the atom bomb. “And that bringeth forth an instrument for his work”: that is the bomb, the nuclear weapons. “And I have created the waster to destroy”: a massive destruction. Like the flood? No: worse than the flood.

“No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper”: what is he talking about? The nuclear weapons; that is the context. In church they say no weapon formed against me, meaning your gossip won’t affect me. It isn’t talking about gossip. Read in context, it is talking about nuclear fire.

“And every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn”: we are going to have power. When these nations raise their lips against us, we are going to condemn them. “This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord”: this is our heritage, brothers and sisters, and our righteousness is of the Lord.

precepts.why:
“I have created the waster to destroy”: what does the waster mean? “This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets”. How are you going to remember what the prophets said if you don’t read the Old Testament? “And of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour”: that is the New Testament.

“Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts”: just as in the days of Noah there were scoffers, there are scoffers today. They don’t believe nuclear war is coming. They don’t believe Christ is returning. They don’t believe we are the twelve tribes of Israel. “And saying, Where is the promise of his coming?” That is what they were saying to Noah as well. “For since the fathers fell asleep”: since Abraham, Isaac and Jacob died, “all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”

“For this they willingly are ignorant of”: what are they willingly ignorant of? The flood. From the creation on there was a great flood that killed everybody on the planet: “the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished”. Christians forget about that. God is an all-loving God, they say, nothing bad happens under his watch. Did he not kill everybody on the planet except Noah, his family and those animals? He is the same yesterday, today and forever.

“But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.” Heavens with an s is not the sky: it means the ruling nations on the earth, and the earth the other nations, and they are reserved unto fire. This is what Isaiah 54 was going into. The waters of Noah will not come again; this time it is fire.

“But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years”. Peter did not change the topic: verse 8 answers verse 4, where is the promise of his coming? Time is different with the Lord than with us. How many generations pass in a thousand years of our time? Peter is saying wake up. “The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward”: the us is the twelve tribes of Israel, “not willing that any should perish”, not willing that any of the Israelites should perish, “but that all should come to repentance.”

“But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night”: Christ is that thief, as we read earlier, “in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.” If you thought it was terrible in the time of Noah, Peter is saying you ain’t seen nothing yet. Wait till this time comes, with nuclear fire, God fire.

“Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”: we have to get our conversation right. We shouldn’t be calling each other mother-effers, or calling the sisters out of their names. Some of you are new and still have that vernacular; change your speech. “Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved”: the heavens are the nations, and they shall be on fire, “and the elements shall melt with fervent heat”. Some of our people see the nations warring and still don’t believe it; they are willingly ignorant of this thing.

When it says no weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper: “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High”: the secret place of the Most High is the Bible, his laws. “Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty”: his shadow means his protection. “I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.”

“Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence. He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day”: the arrow is the weapon, the nuclear weapon, the waster. “Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday”: this is the waster we just read in Isaiah 54:16.

“A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand”: when the waster, that weapon, hits land, you are going to see ten thousand people drop dead, incinerated, at our right hand. “But it shall not come nigh thee”: those brothers and sisters who are alive at that time. “Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.”

Here are the effects of the waster: “And this shall be the plague wherewith the Lord will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet”. The only thing that can do that is nuclear fire, God fire. “And their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.”

“And after three days and an half”: after 350 years. “The Spirit of life from God entered into them”: that is the Holy Spirit entering into us, “and they stood upon their feet”: now we are standing upon our feet, brothers. “And great fear fell upon them which saw them”: the nations are afraid, and when nations are afraid, they get mad and become terrorists to us.

“And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither”: a day is coming when we hear that great voice. This links with Psalms 91. “And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud”: that cloud is the chariot, and that chariot is the ark from the time of Noah. The same thing that delivered us in the time of the great flood is going to deliver us from the flame, the fire. “And their enemies beheld them”: our enemies are going to behold us going into the chariot of God.

“And the same hour was there a great earthquake”: at the same moment those brothers and sisters are taken up, “and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand”: immense death. “And the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven”: our people, although delivered, are going to be afraid. Don’t think Noah wasn’t afraid when he saw all that rain, when they had never seen rain before, with all the people screaming in the water of the flood. It is going to be the same when that God fire hits the earth: people are going to be screaming for salvation, and it is too late. You mocked the Lord; you scoffed the Lord. And at the same time we give glory to the God of heaven.

sense.text: “That men ought always to pray, and not to faint”: we must always pray. Psalms 55:17 says evening, morning and noon we pray. Always pray.

“There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man: And there was a widow in that city”: we are that widow. Remember, he said, I was married unto you, but because we sinned, he refused us. “And she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary”: the widow, which is us, says avenge me of mine enemies. We want revenge.

“And he would not for a while”: remember Psalms 50, all these things hast thou done and I kept silence. It is the same thing. “But afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man”: there is no God beside me, and I regard no man.

“Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her”: because the twelve tribes of Israel trouble him. “Lest by her continual coming she weary me”: the key is her continual coming. Pray. Pray for vengeance, and don’t stop.

“Hear what the unjust judge saith.” Why do they call the Lord unjust? Because a lot of our people think it is unjust for God to put us in slavery and to punish us. It is not. On the street when we teach, they ask, why would an all-loving God do that? You have kids: don’t you punish your kids when they go off? So likewise the Lord.
“And shall not God avenge his own elect”: we are the elect, “which cry day and night unto him”, three times a day, “though he bear long with them?” He bears long with us.

“I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?” Will there be faith? Will the brothers and sisters still be doing it? Will you believe to pray for vengeance? That is what Christ is asking.

Last week the brothers marched on the Road of Remembrance in Jackson, Mississippi, to the abandoned house where Tasia Fortune was found hanging from a tree, read the scriptures there, and prayed: Father, we ask for judgment; we ask for vengeance against our enemies.

precepts.why: The widow: “How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!” We are the widow. Christ is making reference back to this in Luke 18.

sense.text:
We are a people that have been terrorized, pillaged, raped, robbed and murdered. Where is the justice for us? “The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance”: Christianity will make you think you aren’t supposed to read this, but the Bible has it in there for you to rejoice. When you see the vengeance, that is a good thing. When you get to see your enemies, the people who have been oppressing us and doing all kinds of terrorist acts, get that justice, that is rejuvenation; it revitalizes your bones.

“He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked”: smashing skulls and vertebrae and rib cages with your feet. That is a good thing. That is therapy.

Understand what comes with it. When you teach that you want justice, that you want vengeance, that you want payback, your enemy will label you hateful. What comes with teaching the gospel is affliction. Program your mind with that: don’t think you are going to teach that the white man is evil and the wicked of the earth and he is going to leave you alone.

“So that a man shall say”: what does so mean? It goes back to the verse before. Verse 10 is said because verse 11 gives the reason that therapy is in effect: so that you can relax and get that therapy. “Verily there is a reward for the righteous”: surely there is a reward for your trauma, for the evils that have happened to us, and God is going to give it to us. That is therapy. Beautifying the meek with salvation is us putting our enemies in chains and taking the sword to get vengeance on our enemies.

Christianity is not going to teach you that. These lying pastors and this Christianity garbage are going to destroy our people completely if we don’t pull our heads out of it.

precepts.why:
The Bible names the great things in the earth that we should look for, and one of them is to see the joy of your children: “There be nine things which I have judged in mine heart to be happy, and the tenth I will utter with my tongue: A man that hath joy of his children”. Our brothers and sisters who have lost their husbands and their sons don’t get the joy of their children. Their sons and daughters are hung on trees, their lives extinguished. You are supposed to have joy of your children, but an enemy has taken them from you, hung them on trees and murdered them.

“And he that liveth to see the fall of his enemy”: to see the fall of your enemies is therapy. God’s therapy.

sense.text:
Our people have to have their heads pulled out of Christianity to wake up. All of this is for God’s good: what is happening to us is to wake us up and make us face what it is. The Most High is trying to get our attention, and he is going to let these things happen until we acknowledge our offence.

“My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray”: the preachers aren’t telling them anything. The lying garbage of Christianity isn’t teaching our people anything, and our people are being destroyed every day. “They have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace”: we have gotten worse, and we have forgotten our rock, the Bible, Christ.

“All that found them have devoured them”: all our enemies who found us, because they knew we broke the laws of the Most High, came against us and destroyed us. “And their adversaries said, We offend not”: they think they can do this with impunity. And we think we are not worthy of justice, not worthy to be redeemed; we are made to think this is supposed to happen to us. “Because they have sinned against the Lord”: that is what they say. These are the Israelites, they sinned against God, so we can move against them and do what we want with them. “The habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers”: we turned against our father.

“Remove out of the midst of Babylon”: pull your head out of the white man’s behind. Pull your head out of this American system, out of this Christianity, out of everything that has our people thinking backwards. Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins. “And go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans”: go forth out of Babylon the great, the mentality we are subjected to, “and be as the he goats before the flocks.”

“For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations”: the Bishop showed how the Most High created the smith that builds the weapons. We think this man is all powerful, and we forget the power of the Most High. The Most High causes man to create the weapon of his own destruction: he made them build it, and he made them create the button they are going to press. He doesn’t want to press it, but he is going to press it, because the Most High will make him. So what power does he really have? Here is the prophet Jeremiah writing about nuclear weapons way back in his time.

“From the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her”: all these nations have missile warfare ready to press the button, set in array around Babylon the great. “From thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man”: their arrows are their missiles. A mighty expert man means those missiles will not miss their target; they have the coordinates to hit exactly where they are supposed to. Jeremiah is writing about missile coordinates, guided missiles. “None shall return in vain”: there are not going to be any duds. They are all going to hit their target; God set it up like that. That is the kind of power that is coming to deliver us from the hand of our enemies and from all that hate us.

precepts.why:
“The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” She is Babylon the great, America, sitting in the midst of the array of nations that are pointing missiles at her. That is what is coming down now.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore”: the nations round about Babylon the great shall hate this country. “And shall make her desolate and naked”: that is what we just read in Jeremiah. They shall make her naked with those missiles, those arrows like a mighty expert man, and none of them shall return in vain. “And shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire”: that is the weapons.

“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will”: he is going to make them create the weapons and make them press the button. You are going to do what I said, because it is time for me to redeem my people. “And to agree”: to agree with prophecy; they are going to do it regardless of how they feel, “and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.”

“And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.” That is Babylon the great; it is crystal clear. This place is going to be burnt up by those weapons, and when those missiles are fired, we are going to be delivered: the voice says come up hither, and we are taken out while our enemies are burnt right before us. That is the therapy you need: after all the hell we have been caught in in this system, you get to see our enemies fall.
